transmissions.hint: CROW (04) was arrested last night and knew the harbour dead drop. A site an arrested agent knows cannot be clean: it is burned.

correct.text: Command kept everyone away from the harbour. Two men in a parked car waited there all night.

hedged.text: Command got both readings and chose to wait. A day lost, nobody caught.

wrong.text: Command read the site as clean and sent the pickup man. He was arrested at the harbour.

transmissions.hint: ROOK (05) was arrested this morning and knew the border meeting place. The contact missed the meeting and the message says to send no one: arrested.
